scope.intent: Preserve evidence-guided whole-cohort construction and specified scientific analyses as the central contribution; add qualified PNS results and retrospective attribution.

integration.PNS results: Section 5.7, associated Figure 8; optional alternative to existing PNS manuscript insert
integration.Supplementary attribution anatomy: S19, with PNS protocol/author table in S18

evidence_path_convention: Paths below are relative to project_root unless absolute; exact frozen-artifact paths and JSON pointers are retained in the cited audit JSONs.

claims.claim: Agents author executable joint biomarker laws from incomplete evidence and explicit assumptions; generated complete cohorts permit several requested analyses of the same law.
claims.limit: Feasibility and partial agreement; no replacement of clinical measurements, reliable new-population inference or claim of unique agent/statistical superiority.

claims.claim: Q4 four constructions/twelve cohorts retained all six glycemia reference point directions; Q1 additional relationships reduced mean absolute discrepancy for five of six coefficients; sealed iron primary OR and earlier prospective overall criteria were unsuccessful.
claims.limit: Q4 and Q1 developmental/exposed references; six analysis definitions are not six independent clinical studies. All original results, comparisons and limitations remain in the master manuscript.

claims.claim: 30 constructions: 20 CHNS/ENSANUT, 5 PNS, 3 lipids, 2 iron; 90 requested-analysis rows plus 6 supplementary marginal-SD rows.
claims.limit: Defined retrospective subset; not all historical experiments and not 96 independent confirmations. No new row access, sampling or clinical fits.

claims.claim: Source statistic, adopted parameter, full-model requested estimand, generated estimate and measured reference are distinct; many source and assumed inputs can feed one analysis.
claims.limit: REPORTED/DERIVED/ASSUMED describe origin, not ordered credibility. DERIVED may have ASSUMED parents; transferred REPORTED inputs also require applicability assumptions.

claims.claim: Numeric full-model implications exist in the compiled audit for 7 requested records and all 6 SD records; 83 requested records remain uncomputed.
claims.limit: Seven = L03 two slopes plus residual r, and A/B iron OR plus joint prevalence. Do not fill missing theory from literals/source values/generated estimates or claim universal theory-output agreement.

claims.claim: CHNS conditional age improves without a supplied age relationship; ENSANUT glucose-adjusted BMI is derived using assumed covariance. E0/E1 authors are unpaired, and CHNS BMI deterioration does not isolate transport.
claims.limit: Supports qualification of the five-of-six interpretation, not a causal decomposition or proof that more evidence has no value.

claims.claim: L03 residual Pearson r after age/sex/BMI: model 0.132232, generated mean 0.141343, reference 0.512070. Weak generated residual dependence is already implied by the chosen law.
claims.limit: Source pooled unadjusted Spearman is a different operator; no reference residual-r interval is available. No unique cause of clinical discrepancy or overall sampler-validation claim.

claims.claim: Source threshold OR 6.653137; B model retains it. A low-ferritin reweighting preserves OR, then 20% independent Hb redraw changes model OR to 4.645566. Generated A/B means 4.855156/6.362052; weighted reference 17.789776.
claims.limit: Identified consequence of an author-chosen probability-law operation, not biological mechanism or full attribution of source-to-target discrepancy.

claims.claim: Iron B assumption-dependent generated rank correlation 0.411379 is near reference 0.398436; ENSANUT E0 A05 BMI MAE 0.007955 is below all E1 author MAEs 0.021128-0.027184.
claims.limit: Counterexamples to a universal accuracy guarantee, not evidence that provenance never predicts error or that assumptions are generally preferable. No fitted predictive claim.

claims.claim: All 132 Q5 declared source-check entries were unavailable; source quantities still informed parameters, but measured numerical source-fit feedback and revision gain were not demonstrated.
claims.limit: Readiness, generated-only checks and retention must not be called all source-fit checks passed.

claims.claim: Five fresh author contexts, three 3000-row draws each, all initial laws retained and fifteen outputs sealed before three PNS reference analyses were revealed.
claims.limit: New prespecified BP task in a previously exposed PNS family, not wholly unseen cohort/global blinding. Existing selected peso_lab-weighted N=8352 reference, not known national truth.

claims.claim: All-draw SBP BMI slopes 3.081446-4.275566 vs reference 3.523995; DBP 2.886276-3.690607 vs 2.259946; residual r 0.465841-0.646204 vs 0.717184. Slope units mmHg per5kg/m2.
claims.limit: All 15 outputs retained. Seed ranges are fixed-law sampling ranges. Reference intervals are conditional IID row-resampling stability intervals, not survey-design CIs or equivalence margins.

claims.claim: Mean of five author medians = 3.754912,3.078304,0.548151; between-author sample SD =0.225862,0.160106,0.057320. Absolute mean-reference gap/SD =1.02,5.11,2.95.
claims.limit: Descriptive shared-host/shared-packet comparison, not z scores, tests, standard errors, independent clinical replications or calibrated epistemic uncertainty. Do not substitute median-of-medians ratios.

claims.claim: Source BMI coefficients0.7754/0.5967 enter pre-selection means; per5 values3.8770/2.9835. Conditional rho assumptions0.50/0.65/0.50/0.55/0.55. Nonlinear means, heteroscedasticity, selection and different source/requested adjustments prevent equating literal parameters with requested estimands.
claims.limit: All PNS numeric whole-law requested implications are uncomputed. Raw r from rounded SDs is not reported adjusted residual r; SE is not residual SD or transport uncertainty. A02's literal rho0.65 is not sampled median0.644023.

claims.claim: L01/L03 subtract modeled between-sex variance before choosing within-sex variances. L02 generated mean TC SD43.6778 is near reference42.8466 while residual r0.108283 remains below0.512070.
claims.limit: Do not describe all lipid outcomes as too narrow or infer marginal/residual-SD confusion.

review_required_after_integration: Check that every first PNS mention preserves the exposed-family qualification.
Keep theory coverage at 7 requested plus6 SD;83 requested remain uncomputed.
Avoid merging source coefficients, literal parameters and sampled estimates into one column.
Keep the PNS mean-of-author-medians ratio definition and conditional reference uncertainty.
Retain all existing negative results, comparison limitations and references.
Do not describe retrospective provenance labels as prospective predictions or an ordered quality scale.
